title: Web Crawler Restrictions, AI Training Datasets & Political Biases
findings: Due to crawler restrictions on moderate websites, AI training datasets are becoming increasingly skewed towards hyperpartisan content. This content features an over-representation of religious terminology. In hyperpartisan right-leaning text, religious word pairs like (Jesus; God), (Christ; Jesus), and (Faith; God) are overrepresented, and terms like 'God', 'Church', 'Testament', and 'Christian' co-occur frequently with demographic terms. In hyperpartisan left-leaning text, 'Jewish' co-occurs with 'Community'. This suggests that models trained on this skewed data may inherit these representations.
